text: Photographer Adam Stanheight and oncologist Lawrence Gordon wake [chained by the ankle|images|ropes, cages and executions] at opposite ends of a derelict bathroom, a corpse with a revolver lying between them. A tape orders Lawrence to [kill Adam by six o'clock|rules|everything has a price] or his wife and daughter will die, and the hacksaws they find are too weak for the chains. Their captor is the Jigsaw Killer, [who tests his victims' will to live|threat|people who kill], and as the hours pass each man's secrets, from [paid spying|wrong|broken trust] to an affair, come out.
